استقطعا (form X)
# اِسْتَقْطَعَا (istaqṭaʕā) /is.taq.tˤa.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَقْطَعَ (istaqṭaʕa)
# اُسْتُقْطِعَا (ustuqṭiʕā) /us.tuq.tˤi.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَقْطَعَ (istaqṭaʕa)
# اِسْتَقْطِعَا (istaqṭiʕā) /is.taq.tˤi.ʕaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَقْطَعَ (istaqṭaʕa)
